news.headline: Invus and TCG Crossover disclose ~6% passive stakes in Abivax via SEC 13G/A filings
news.summary: Invus Public Equities and affiliates reported beneficial ownership of approximately 6.0% of Abivax's ordinary shares as of June 30, 2026, while TCG Crossover Fund I and II reported a combined roughly 7% stake; both certified passive investment intent.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA provided constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on its NDA submission strategy, including content and format, for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis. The company remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132
news.summary: Morgan Stanley reiterated a bullish stance on Abivax and lifted its price target citing improved commercial visibility and de-risked regulatory path following the positive pre-NDA FDA meeting.

news.headline: Abivax strengthens commercial capabilities with strategic leadership appointments
news.summary: Abivax expanded its senior commercial team across marketing, patient services, sales and market access with experienced hires from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie and Eli Lilly, aiming to build launch readiness for a potential U.S. commercialization of obefazimod.

news.headline: Biotech Abivax re-engages investment bank Centerview for Big Pharma takeover talks
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported Abivax has re-engaged Centerview to field renewed Big Pharma acquisition interest, reviving speculation the company could be bought before a planned 2027 U.S. launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Valerio Therapeutics Announces Development Collaboration with Abivax
news.summary: Abivax and Valerio Therapeutics signed a binding term sheet for an exclusive worldwide R&D collaboration to identify and design next-generation therapeutic candidates for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases; Valerio will receive an upfront payment of about €2.4 million plus milestones and royalties, subject to a definitive agreement.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Abivax reaffirmed (positive pre-NDA meeting, July 30, 2026) it remains on track to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by end-2026.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Scheduled half-year 2026 results and business update release.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA filing for obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Planned European marketing authorization application filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis.

catalysts.label: Definitive agreement with Valerio Therapeutics
catalysts.detail: Binding term sheet signed July 16, 2026 for an exclusive R&D collaboration on next-gen IMID candidates; final co-ownership/license agreement still to be executed.

catalysts.label: Lead combination-therapy candidate selection
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to select a lead obefazimod combination candidate (targeting IL-23, a4b7, PDE-4 or AhR mechanisms) to advance into development.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's 12-week data
catalysts.detail: Interim efficacy/safety readout expected from the Phase 2b Crohn's disease trial of obefazimod.

catalysts.label: Takeover/partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Persistent Big Pharma buyout chatter (Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca previously named) continues, with Centerview re-engaged in July 2026 and crossover investors (TCG Crossover, Invus) building stakes disclosed August 13, 2026.

pulse: Abivax remains well-capitalized (post-$920M raise, runway into Q4 2029) and de-risked on the regulatory front after a positive July 30 pre-NDA FDA meeting, while simultaneously building out U.S. commercial infrastructure and extending its pipeline via a new July 16 R&D collaboration term sheet with Valerio Therapeutics. Crossover investors TCG Crossover and Invus each disclosed roughly 6% passive stakes on August 13, and Big Pharma takeover speculation persists (Centerview re-engaged mid-July) though no formal bid has emerged. No major company-specific news broke between mid- and late-August; the next scheduled catalyst is the September 21 H1 2026 results release, ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing.
